title: OSTERA Public Review
description: One public review of one draft, stored as docs/reviews/<shortname>/v<version>/<draft>/review.yaml, where <version> is the version the draft is expected to become and <draft> is the draft number in two digits.

shortname.description: The work item's short name, the same as in the draft file name and in registry.yaml once a number is assigned.

draft.description: The draft number, without leading zeros. The folder and the file name use two digits: draft 1 is folder 01 and draft-ts-jcs-01.pdf. Draft numbers may start again at 1 for a new version.

type.description: The document type code in the draft name, defined in registry.yaml.

version.description: The version the draft is expected to become, such as "1.0". Always quoted. It is also the folder name, such as v1.0.

working_group.description: An id from registry.yaml. It is also the name of the Working Group's repository, where comments are filed as issues.

closes.description: After opens. At least one review of each version's drafts must last 30 days or more, closing at least 30 days after it opens, before that version is published (Working Methods, Article 29). closes may later move to a later date, but never to an earlier one.

changes.description: What changed since the previous public review, if there was one.

withdrawn.description: Added only if the Secretariat ends the review early.

disposition.description: Added after the review closes: a link to the Working Group's response to the comments.
